scope: Independent review diagnostic only. Root model and PDFs unchanged. Existing outputs are already known; no blind-selection claim.

interpretation: These are joint assumptions with no assigned likelihood. The control tests sensitivity of one positive-entry example, not a forecast that a contract was lost or an exhaustive bound.
